nativeAbilityInventory.shape: InventoryComponent.AbilitySlots: 3 columns x 2 lines, 6 capacity; ItemAbility Primary/Support
nativeAbilityInventory.decision: Use native Ability1-4 execution/input paths only; do not use rune acquisition/progression as RPG state.

nodePointerDrag.thresholdDecision: Production threshold remains 4 UI units; audit probe measures raw continuity.

persistentNodePosition.storage: plugin data properties by player UUID

blockers.BLOCKER_GLOBAL_INPUT_REGISTRATION: The 0.7.0-pre.1 client contains contextual InputActionManager/InputActionContext architecture, but the public server mod API and installed assets expose no supported third-party global input-action registration or settings-category API. Client patching and Settings.json mutation are out of scope.
blockers.BLOCKER_C_DEFAULT_OWNERSHIP: No C consumer is serialized in pre-release Settings.json; un-serialized default ownership must be verified in the live client settings UI before any remap decision.
blockers.BLOCKER_INVENTORY_AUGMENTATION: Page.Inventory and Page.Custom remain distinct; no supported hook injects a custom pane into the native inventory. The master specification's standalone Character page remains feasible and is the selected route.
blockers.BLOCKER_REAL_CLIENT: UI lifecycle, HUD coexistence/restore, in-page low-level mouse delivery, Ability1-4 packet emission, exact C/K defaults, HTDevLib particle playback, screenshots, and timing still require the installed native client.
